Hey, there. It is SMASH LEGENDS!

⚡  Changes and improvements ⚡

■ Legends balance improvement

 Dev team Comments: The percentage mobility affects the game is higher than we expected in the early days. 

Therefore, we are trying to balance the legends that we think it is beyond than originally designed availability.


In particular, Red has been developed to take strategic advantage by approaching foes in stealth and giving instant damages. However, we figured that Red can take advantage in a battle regardless of situations. 
So, with this upcoming patch, we reduced the attack range as well as the number of times skills available.
The team will check how it works continuously.


- Red
: The additional damage of the ultimate is reduced by 150.
: Basic attack damage is reduced from 1,300 to 1,100.
: Skill cooldown increases by 2 seconds.
: The aerial attack range is reduced to in accordance with the effect range.

- Cindy
: Skill cooldown increases by 1 second.
: When using aerial skills, the attack judgment range is reduced.
: When skill cooldown is reset due to a foe hit by an aerial skill, the time it takes to use the next skill slightly increases.

- Kaiser
: When using aerial skills, the same amount of damage will be applied for both the first and the second attack.
(Total amount of damage stays the same. Previously, for the first attack, it gave more damages than the second one.)
: When the jump skill attack hits, stunned time for foes will be increased.
: The Range for Kaiser to get attacked has been reduced. 


⚡  Bug fixes ⚡

■ Legends

- Fixed an issue where Red’s basic attack damage was not applied properly when a foe was located close to the Red.
- Fixed an issue where Red’s aerial attack damage was not done properly as much as the attack effect range.
- When Red gets attacked right after she turned invisible, knock-back will now occur.
- Fixed an issue where attack damage was not applied in a row sometimes when Cindy does basic attack.
- Fixed an issue where Kaiser’s additional attack’s knock-back that gets available when using Ultimate and basic attack damage were not the same.
- Fixed an issue when using the Witch Queen’s skill, the attack was not applied as much as the effect range of the magical orb.
